headline: Howmet Aerospace Tops Q3 Estimates and Raises Full-Year Guidance
summary: Howmet Aerospace reported third-quarter results that beat analyst expectations and upgraded its full-year financial outlook.
why: Howmet Aerospace manufactures high-engineered components for commercial aerospace and defense original equipment manufacturers.

impacts.name: Howmet Aerospace Inc
impacts.why: Howmet Aerospace beat Q3 revenue and earnings forecasts while lifting its full-year guidance.
